description: This file defines the PHP class ADODB_sybase, which implements a database driver for Sybase within the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It includes methods for database connection management, executing queries, handling transactions, and retrieving schema information, as well as a corresponding recordset class for fetching data from Sybase databases.

classes.name: ADODB_sybase
classes.description: Database driver class for Sybase within ADOdb. Handles connection, transaction, and query execution specific to Sybase databases.

classes.name: ADODBRecordset_sybase
classes.description: Recordset class for fetching and iterating over results from Sybase queries, specific to ADOdb for Sybase.

classes.name: ADODBRecordSet_array_sybase
classes.description: Helper class for parsing date strings and converting to timestamps within Sybase recordsets in ADOdb.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted identity value from the database.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: RowLock
methods.description: Obtains a row lock on specified tables and conditions.

methods.name: SelectDB
methods.description: Selects the database to operate on.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Retrieves the last error message from the Sybase driver.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the Sybase database.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the Sybase database.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query on the database.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with limit and offset capabilities.

methods.name: UnixDate
methods.description: Converts a date string to a Unix timestamp (static method).

methods.name: UnixTimeStamp
methods.description: Converts a timestamp string to a Unix timestamp (static method).

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Formats a date according to the specified format string in SQL for Sybase.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns of a table from the schema.
